Thank you all for those reports. Let me summarize what I'm recording on the campaign-freeze checklist before I make my decision:

Now, regarding sequencing: Our normal planning preference is to run one material family completely before changing to the other to avoid setup loss. We have Order K (320 aluminum brackets) and Order L (180 stainless enclosures). Both constraints reported — the dimensional scan, the regulator replacement, and the shipping deadline — all apply to Order L (stainless). There are no reported constraints on Order K (aluminum).

I'm considering running Order K first (aluminum, no constraints) and then Order L (stainless, with the 2-hour regulator replacement and 30-unit dimensional scan built in before the full run), ensuring everything is staged by Friday 10:00. Does anyone see any issue with that sequence, or do I have what I need to sign off?
